title: Are you a movie-goer?
excerpt: I’ve seen a bunch of great ones lately, including Les Mis. My Aussie friend Jarrod McKenna writes about the film here – highly recommended: http://www.redletterchristians.org/do-you-hear-the-people-sing-m-l-king-les-miserables-case-for-a-socialism-of-grace/
